item.title: Launch HN: Inkeep (YC W23) – Open Source Agent Builder
item.description:
📝 Inkeep Agents With Inkeep, you can build and ship AI Agents with a No-Code Visual Builder or TypeScript SDK. agents-manage-ui: Visual Builder web interface for creating and managing Agents. agents-cli: Includes various handy utilities, including inkeep push and inkeep pull which sync your TypeScript SDK code with the Visual Builder.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/inkeep/agents

item.title: Working with the Amiga's RAM and Rad Disks
item.description:
📝 The Amiga has a RAM disk. On a two meg system with two floppy drives, it could even be an option to set up a RAD disk - a fixed-size RAM disk that essentially emulates a floppy drive. RAD (somehow) stands for Recoverable RAM Disk.
🔗 Read more: https://www.datagubbe.se/ramdisk/
